blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Communities living near three rivers in northern Metro Cebu are expected to benefit from additional flood monitoring and warning facilities distributed on Monday, November 9, as authorities strengthen preparations against flooding. The Flood Early Warning System (FEWS), developed through a partnership between the Department of Science and Technology–Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (DOST-Pagasa) and the National Disaster Management Research Institute (NDMI) of South Korea, covers the Butuanon River in Mandaue City, Cansaga River in Consolacion and Cotcot River in Liloan.
